decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (MS/2017015/000, MS/2017015/01, MS/2017015/02, MS/2017015/03, MS/2017015/04, MS/2017015/05, MS/2017015/06, MS/2017015/07, MS/2017015/08, MS/2017015/09, MS/2017015/10, MS/2017015/11, MS/2017015/12, Received: 05/06/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevations shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Joint application for the erection of a rear outrigger roof extension to both the houses.
